entities.name: Muhammad al-Hashimi al-Tilimsani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shaykh Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Hāshimī ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Tilimsānī was an Algerian and Syrian Sufi saint and scholar, considered by some to have been the “renewer (mujaddid) of religion” and also the Shaʿrānī of his time.
